key_policy: Choice key = natural 1-5 word English name of the label, fixed for every split, variant and model (DESIGN field rule 2, D8). Descriptions (D_*) and propositions (P_*) are authored separately per pool and never live in this file.
label_id_type: predicate and scale ids defined here (the source has no label ids for them)

labels.gold_rule: 1 if median insult >= 3; 0 if <= 1; soft-only (hard_ok=false) if 2

labels.construct: how insulting the comment is (MHS insult item, 0-4)
labels.rule: R0 + R12 SOFT; MIRROR wording 'How free of insult...' uses the same anchors reversed (R7)
labels.source_field: insult (per annotator 0-4; gold level = median over >= 3 annotators; soft = annotator distribution)
